The emergency communication system built into SYNC 4 911 Assist offers peace of mind on every journey.

The spray-in bedliner protects your cargo area from damage while maintaining the truck's rugged aesthetic. WHY PURCHASE YOUR NEXT VEHICLE FROM BOB RUTH FORD?

At Bob Ruth Ford, we provide a better way to buy both new and used vehicles with upfront pricing, transparency, and respect for your time.
Every pre-owned vehicle is inspected for condition and performance. Vehicles are competitively priced based on mileage, condition, and current market data.
As the home of the VIP Experience, we offer no-haggle pricing, 100% online purchasing, curbside pickup, nationwide delivery, and access to 40+ lenders for competitive financing options.

This 2027 Ford Expedition Max Active in Nocturnal Blue Metallic represents the full-size family vehicle you've been looking for. With just 3 miles on the odometer, this is essentially a new vehicle with the advantage of immediate availability. The EcoBoost 3.5L V6 twin-turbocharged engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD capability delivers dependable performance across all driving conditions, achieving 15 city and 22 highway MPG.

- Power Panoramic Vista Roof with Power Shade
- 3rd Row 40/20/40 PowerFold Flexible Seating with Remote Controls
- 2nd Row Power-Folding Captain's Chairs with Armrests and Tip-and-Slide
- BlueCruise Equipped with Lane Change Assist and 1 Year + 90-Day Plan
- Ford Connectivity Package with 5G, Unlimited Wi-Fi Hotspot, and 7-Year Coverage
- Heated Front Captain's Chairs and Heated Steering Wheel
- Google Maps Navigation System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Dual Power-Folding Sideview Mirrors with Memory and Ground Illuminator
- Ford Split Gate with Open-on-Approach Power Upper and Lower Tailgate
- Pro Power Onboard 400W with Console and Cargo Area Outlets
- Auto-Dimming Rearview Mirror with 360-Degree Zone Lighting
- Remote Start with 4-Door Intelligent Access
- SiriusXM with 360L Radio and 6-Speaker Audio
- Ford Co-Pilot360 Active 2.0 Safety Technologies
- 18-Inch Dark Alloy Painted Aluminum Wheels

The Expedition Max Active seats up to seven passengers with thoughtful design for both comfort and practicality. Captain's chairs in the second row include power-folding capability and heated surfaces, while the third row features remote power-folding seats for easy access and storage flexibility. The power panoramic vista roof with its power shade allows you to control natural light and air flow, enhancing the open feeling of the cabin on every journey.

Convenience and technology are woven throughout this vehicle. The Ford Connectivity Package provides 5G access with unlimited Wi-Fi hotspot capability for seven years, keeping you connected during work calls or family streaming. BlueCruise enables hands-free highway driving on 97% of controlled access highways across the U.S. and Canada with lane change assist, reducing driver fatigue during long trips. Remote start allows you to warm up or cool down the Expedition before entering, and the digital device holder keeps your phone accessible.

Safety features include Ford Co-Pilot360 Active 2.0, exterior parking camera, emergency communication with 911 Assist, and multiple airbags including front, side, and overhead protection. The 4-door intelligent access system locks and unlocks automatically as you approach. Power-disc brakes with electronic stability control and traction control provide confident stopping performance in varied conditions.

Practicality meets everyday utility with front and second-row floor liners protecting your carpeting, the Ford Split Gate that opens in multiple configurations for efficient loading, and Pro Power Onboard outlets for charging devices or running small equipment. Rain-sensitive windshield wipers adapt to changing weather conditions, while the dual-zone automatic climate control keeps front and rear passengers comfortable.

The 2027 Ford Expedition Max Active delivers the space and capability your family needs for any adventure. This full-size SUV combines premium comfort with advanced technology to make every journey more enjoyable and connected.

- Equipment Group 202A Touring Package
- Family Travel Package
- Ford Co-Pilot360 Active 2.0
- Power Panoramic Vista Roof with Power Sunshade
- 3rd Row PowerFold Flexible Seating with Remote Head Restraints
- Heated ActiveX-Trimmed Front Captain's Chairs
- Heated Steering Wheel
- BlueCruise Equipped with 90-Day Trial
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Integration
- SiriusXM with 360L
- Pro Power Onboard 400W
- Integrated Trailer Brake Control with Heavy-Duty Towing
- Google Maps Navigation System
- Ford Digital Experience
- 360-Degree Zone Lighting

The Expedition Max Active is built on capability with its EcoBoost 3.5L V6 Twin Turbocharged engine paired with a 10-Speed Automatic transmission and 4WD, delivering 15 city and 22 highway mpg for a full-size SUV. The three-row seating arrangement provides flexible configurations to accommodate passengers and cargo, with power-folding options in both the second and third rows for convenient operation.

Interior amenities focus on passenger comfort and convenience. Dual-zone automatic temperature control keeps front passengers comfortable independent of rear conditions, while rear air conditioning extends climate control throughout the cabin. Memory driver seats and power adjustability for both driver and passenger ensure personalized positioning. The 9.75 rear axle and 3.73 front axle ratio optimize performance and efficiency.

Safety and driver assistance features provide confidence on every drive. Ford Co-Pilot360 Active 2.0 includes Lane Change Assist and Intersection Assist to help you navigate traffic safely. Auto High-Beam Headlights and 360-Degree Zone Lighting enhance visibility in all conditions. The vehicle includes dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and overhead airbags, along with Electronic Stability Control and four-wheel independent suspension for controlled handling.

Technology integration makes connectivity seamless. The Ford Connectivity Package includes one year of service, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto support, and a digital device holder for your smartphone. Remote Start and 4-Door Intelligent Access let you control your vehicle from a distance. The Rear-View Camera and speed-sensitive rain-sensitive windshield wipers add practical convenience to daily driving.

The exterior design combines function with style. Dual power-folding sideview mirrors with autofold simplify parking in tight spaces. The Ford Split Gate tailgate provides flexible cargo access. Eighteen-inch dark alloy painted aluminum wheels with all-season tires complete the Professional appearance.

At Tim Short Ford of LaFollette, we serve the entire East Tennessee market Knoxville, Oak Ridge, Clinton, Caryville, Jellico, Rocky Top, Lake City, and beyond. Come test drive it today or call our team for financing options. This one checks every box!

We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this exceptional truck firsthand.

With an extended-range fuel tank and reasonable fuel economy at 17 city and 23 highway MPG, this truck balances capability with efficiency.

Inside, the Lariat trim establishes comfort as a priority. Leather-trimmed heated and ventilated front seats with 10-way power adjustment accommodate all-day comfort, while the heated steering wheel and wireless charging pad add practical luxury. The twin panel moonroof floods the cabin with light, and the premium B&O Sound System elevates every drive.

Technology seamlessly integrates into your daily routine. The 360 degree camera system provides complete visibility around the truck, while connected built-in navigation keeps you on course. SYNC 4 with enhanced voice recognition lets you stay focused on the road.

BoxLink integration with four premium locking cleats secures cargo precisely where needed, LED box lighting illuminates nighttime work, and the power tailgate with integrated work surface simplifies loading and task execution. The Trailer Tow Package includes an integrated trailer brake controller and Pro Trailer Backup Assist, making towing and reversing trailers more manageable.

Premium exterior details reflect the Lariat's position in the lineup. Chrome accents include the 2-bar grille, door and tailgate handles, running boards, and tow hooks. - Leather seating surfaces with heated front bucket seats
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto smartphone integration
- Honda Satellite-Linked Navigation System with real-time routing
- Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow technology
- Lane Keeping Assist System for highway confidence
- 160-Watt AM/FM/HD/SiriusXM audio system with steering wheel controls
- Blind Spot Information System warning alerts
- Power moonroof for natural light and ventilation
- Front dual-zone automatic temperature control with rear air conditioning

The 3.5L V6 SOHC i-VTEC engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission delivers balanced performance, achieving 19 city and 28 highway MPG. This powertrain combination provides the torque necessary for confident merging and passing while maintaining reasonable fuel economy for regular driving. The front-wheel drive layout ensures stable handling and maximizes interior cabin space a defining characteristic of the minivan category.

Safety systems integrate throughout this model to protect all occupants. Electronic Stability Control, anti-lock brakes on all four wheels, and a comprehensive airbag system including front dual-stage airbags, front side-impact airbags, and overhead airbags form a protective envelope. The Lane Keeping Assist System actively helps maintain lane position on highways, while the Blind Spot Information System provides visibility awareness for safer lane changes and merging maneuvers.

Comfort and convenience features reflect the Touring trim's focus on family-friendly daily living. Heated front seats warm passengers during cold mornings, while automatic temperature control with dual-zone front and rear capability allows individual comfort preferences. The power moonroof brings natural light and fresh air to the cabin, and the HomeLink garage door transmitter reduces fumbling for remotes when arriving home loaded with groceries and children.

The Honda Satellite-Linked Navigation System provides turn-by-turn directions with real-time traffic awareness, helping you navigate unfamiliar routes with confidence. Push-button door locks, remote keyless entry, and the power liftgate streamline loading and entry, particularly valuable when managing multiple passengers and cargo. Memory seat technology automatically positions the driver's seat to your preference each time you enter the vehicle.

With 32,288 miles on the odometer, this Odyssey Touring remains well within its prime operating years and carries the quality assurance you expect from Honda's engineering. The leather-trimmed interior shows well, and the vehicle maintains the operational readiness that comes with proper factory maintenance. This minivan represents a solid choice for families seeking dependable three-row seating, modern connectivity, and genuine safety focus in a proven platform.

The three-row configuration with bench seating in the rear provides flexibility for passenger arrangements.

The TRD Off-Road package positions this Tacoma as a serious tool for challenging terrain. The 3.5L V6 engine produces solid power while the 6-speed automatic transmission offers smooth, responsive performance whether you're navigating city streets or rugged trails. The black overfenders and TRD-specific styling give this Tacoma a purposeful appearance that matches its character. Safety features include dual front impact airbags, side impact airbags, and a knee airbag designed to protect occupants in various collision scenarios. Electronic stability control, traction control, and brake assist give you confidence in slippery or demanding situations. The security system and emergency communication capability complete the protection package.

This Tacoma comes ready to work and ready to reward you with dependable service. Come see it and experience how well this truck balances rugged capability with daily drivability.

The 4WD system includes a locking center differential for enhanced terrain capability, and the electronic modulated air suspension adapts to road conditions for a composed ride whether you're carrying a full passenger load or cruising the highway.

Advanced airbag protection includes dual front, front side-mounted, knee airbags for front occupants, plus roll-sensing side curtain airbags for all rows. Blind spot monitoring, trailer sway control, and LATCH anchors for child safety seats round out the comprehensive safety suite.

Practical features enhance daily convenience and capability. The tilt/slide moonroof with sunshade brings natural light and ventilation, while power windows, locks, and the power liftgate with jam protection simplify operation. Auto-dimming heated outside mirrors with memory settings reduce glare and remember your preferences. Chrome exterior trim, running boards, a roof rack, and rear spoiler complement the Black exterior, while fog lamps and automatic headlights with cleaning function improve visibility.

This single-owner Sequoia represents a substantial investment in family transportation, and we invite you to schedule a test drive to experience its commanding capability and refined comfort firsthand.

This 2016 Lexus RX 350 presents a compelling combination of sophisticated engineering and thoughtful design. Finished in gray, this midsize luxury SUV delivers the refined presence you expect from the Lexus nameplate. The responsive 3.5L V6 engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive provides capable performance while returning 19 city and 26 highway MPG, balancing capability with efficiency.

- Blind Spot Monitor with Rear Cross Traffic Alert and Lane Change Assist
- Lexus Safety System Plus with pre-collision system and pedestrian detection
- Bi-LED headlamps with Automatic High Beam
- All-Speed Dynamic Radar Cruise Control (DRCC)
- Lane Departure Alert with Steering Assist
- 12.3" Navigation System with advanced voice command and SiriusXM
- Heated and Ventilated Front Seats
- Heated Matte Bamboo Steering Wheel
- Power Tilt and Slide Moonroof
- Touch-Free Power Rear Door
- Intuitive Parking Assist with clearance and back sonar
- Premium Package with Driver Seat and Mirror Memory (3 Settings)
- 3500 lbs Tow Prep Package with Heavy Duty Radiator and Alternator
- Cold Weather Package
- Leather Seat Trim and Matte Bamboo Interior Trim

The interior reflects Lexus attention to detail with matte bamboo accents throughout, authentic leather seating surfaces, and a leather-wrapped steering wheel. The 12.3-inch navigation system offers comprehensive route planning alongside SiriusXM satellite radio with NavTraffic, NavWeather, and specialty programming. Bluetooth hands-free connectivity and Lexus Enform App Suite integration keep you connected seamlessly. The intuitive parking assist system with rear camera and sonar guidance makes maneuvering in tight spaces straightforward.

Safety technologies define this RX 350. The Lexus Safety System Plus bundle incorporates pre-collision detection with pedestrian recognition, adaptive all-speed cruise control, and active lane keeping with steering assistance. Blind spot monitoring with rear cross traffic alert provides critical visibility when changing lanes or backing out. The bi-LED headlamp system with automatic high beam maintains optimal road illumination without manual adjustment.

Comfort amenities enhance daily driving. Heated and ventilated front seats adjust to your preference, while the heated bamboo steering wheel provides warmth on cold mornings. The power moonroof opens to natural light, and the touch-free power rear door operates at a gesture, convenient when hands are full. Driver seat, steering, and mirror memory preserves your preferred positions across three settings. Rain-sensing wipers adjust automatically to changing weather conditions.

This Lexus RX 350 represents dependable luxury that continues to reward its owner. We invite you to schedule your test drive and discover how this vehicle's blend of safety, comfort, and capability aligns with your driving needs.

Genuine wood inlays on the dashboard, doors, and center console reinforce the quality feel of the interior. Dual-zone automatic climate control with rear air conditioning maintains comfort for all passengers.

Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity keep your smartphone integrated, and the Audi Phone Box enhances signal strength for reliable hands-free communication. Safety features demonstrate Audi's commitment to protection. The suite includes dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, overhead airbags, and occupant sensing technology. Electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel independent suspension work together to maintain stability. Audi Pre Sense Rear technology monitors traffic behind the vehicle, while the Parking System Plus with front and rear acoustic sensors assists with low-speed maneuvering.

This Q5 Premium Plus offers the refinement and capability expected from Audi, with the added benefit of low mileage and clean history. We invite you to schedule a test drive to experience the quality of this vehicle firsthand.

The backup camera provides visibility when reversing, while the low tire pressure warning system keeps you informed about maintenance needs.

Bluetooth connectivity keeps you connected hands-free, while the trip computer tracks your efficiency and fuel consumption in real time.

This 2016 Acura ILX represents a well-appointed compact sedan that combines practical features with refined styling in a blue exterior that turns heads. Whether your commute takes you across town or beyond, this vehicle is ready to serve your needs with reliability and comfort.

description:
This 2018 Audi Q5 2.0T Premium Plus quattro in striking blue represents a well-appointed compact luxury SUV ready to enhance your daily driving experience. With 91,542 miles on the odometer, this vehicle combines refined engineering with practical versatility for the discerning buyer.

- Cold Weather Package with heated rear seats, heated steering wheel, and shift paddles
- Navigation Package featuring Audi Virtual Cockpit with 12.3 fully digital instrument cluster
- Premium Plus Package including Full LED headlights and Audi Advanced Key keyless entry
- 20-inch 5-spoke segment design wheels with all-weather tires
- 8.3 MMI Navigation Plus infotainment system with handwriting recognition technology
- Panoramic sunroof with tilt, slide, and power sunshade
- Leather seating surfaces with 8-way power front bucket seats and driver seat memory
- 3-step heated front and rear seats for enhanced comfort year-round
- Parking System Plus with front and rear acoustic sensors
- Audi Side Assist with Pre Sense Rear and Rear Cross Traffic Assist
- Full suite of safety features including multiple airbags and electronic stability control
- SiriusXM All Access Service with three-month trial subscription
- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone and rear air conditioning
- Stainless steel door sills with high gloss window surrounds
- Audi smartphone interface supporting Apple CarPlay and Android Auto

The 2.0L TFSI engine paired with the 7-speed automatic S tronic transmission and quattro all-wheel drive delivers balanced performance and capability. The vehicle achieves an EPA-estimated 23 mpg in the city and 27 mpg on the highway, making it efficient for both urban commuting and longer excursions. The quattro system provides confident traction and handling in varied weather conditions throughout the year.

Inside, the Premium Plus package elevates the ownership experience with advanced technology and comfort amenities. The heated auto-dimming and power-adjustable mirrors with body-colored finish offer convenience and style, while the leather shift knob and multifunction steering wheel add tactile refinement. The Audi Virtual Cockpit provides a customizable digital display that keeps critical information at your fingertips, and the MMI Navigation Plus system integrates seamlessly with modern connectivity options.

Climate control extends throughout the cabin with front dual zone automatic temperature regulation and rear air conditioning, while heated seats and a heated steering wheel ensure warmth during colder months. The power liftgate opens access to a spacious cargo area, complemented by a black privacy trunk cover for added discretion and security.

Safety technology is comprehensive, featuring a panoramic camera system with rear parking display, brake assist, traction control, and an array of airbags positioned throughout the cabin. The electronic stability control and four-wheel independent suspension work together to maintain composure through turns and over uneven surfaces.

This Q5 represents a mature, well-equipped example of Audi's commitment to blending luxury, technology, and everyday practicality. We invite you to schedule a test drive and discover what this premium compact SUV can offer your lifestyle.

Inside, the cabin reflects Dodge's commitment to driver-focused design. The Uconnect 3 system with its 5-inch display keeps you connected through Bluetooth integration and voice command functionality. Your passengers benefit from the split folding rear seat, offering flexibility for cargo when needed. Climate control operates independently across the front dual zones, ensuring personalized comfort for both driver and front passenger. The power driver seat allows you to find your ideal driving position easily.

Safety systems throughout the vehicle include electronic stability control, traction control, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, overhead airbags, and anti-whiplash front head restraints. A low tire pressure warning system helps you maintain optimal tire condition. The security system and panic alarm provide peace of mind whether you're parked or on the road.

The black exterior presents a timeless, sophisticated appearance. This 2017 model shows 78,625 miles on the odometer and represents solid value in the muscle car segment. The power sunroof adds an element of openness and style, while the Challenger's iconic exterior proportions remain as striking as ever.

We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this Challenger firsthand. Behind the wheel, you'll understand why this model continues to resonate with drivers who appreciate authentic performance and presence.

This 2026 Toyota 4Runner SR5 in Blue delivers the capability and comfort you need for any adventure, whether you're navigating daily commutes or exploring off-road terrain with confidence and reliability.

- Third row seating fabric

The 2.4L 4-cylinder engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and 4WD system offers a balanced combination of capability and efficiency. You'll appreciate the responsive power when you need it, while the 19 city and 25 highway MPG ratings help keep fuel costs reasonable for a vehicle of this size and capability.

Comfort comes standard with front bucket seats, a split-folding rear seat, and genuine third-row seating for families who need extra space. The front center armrest and rear seat center armrest add convenience for all passengers. Climate control features include automatic temperature management, front dual-zone A/C, and rear window defroster to maintain comfort in any season.

Safety is prioritized with Toyota's comprehensive approach. Anti-whiplash front head restraints, knee airbags, and overhead airbags work with Electronic Stability Control, brake assist, and 4-wheel disc ABS brakes. The low tire pressure warning system and Safety Connect emergency communication (1-year trial included) provide additional peace of mind.

The interior reflects practical luxury with an overhead console, passenger and driver vanity mirrors, and front reading lights. The leather steering wheel and shift knob add a touch of refinement, while steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your focus on the road. Variably intermittent wipers and a rear window wiper handle weather conditions effectively.

Outside, you'll notice the body-color bumpers, spoiler, and 17-inch dark-gray painted alloy wheels that contribute to the vehicle's professional appearance. Heated door mirrors and the exterior parking camera enhance visibility and convenience in any driving situation.

This 2023 Cadillac Escalade Premium Luxury delivers the commanding presence and refined capability you expect from a full-size luxury SUV, with the attention to detail that separates exceptional vehicles from the ordinary.

- AKG Studio 19-speaker audio system for premium sound quality

- Heated and ventilated driver and front passenger seats with heated rear seats

- 22-inch 14-spoke alloy wheels with polished finish
- Automatic seat belt tightening and rear camera mirror with washer
- Three years of OnStar and connected services premium plan included

- Four-wheel independent suspension with electronic stability control

The 6.2L V8 engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission and AWD ensures confident performance suited to any driving condition. This vehicle offers the authority and refinement that full-size luxury requires, delivering capability without compromise.

Inside, the Premium Luxury edition surrounds you with quality materials and thoughtful design. The Brandy leather seating with faceted quilting creates an atmosphere of sophistication, while fine line Brandy wood trim adds warmth and visual interest. Front seats offer heated and ventilated functionality, and the heated rear seats ensure comfort for all passengers. Memory seat adjustments allow you to personalize your driving position effortlessly.

Technology integration is seamless and comprehensive. The reconfigurable full-color head-up display keeps essential information within your line of sight, while the AKG Studio 19-speaker system delivers exceptional audio clarity throughout the cabin. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto put your smartphone's capabilities at your fingertips, and the included three-year OnStar and connected services plan provides safety, security, and peace of mind.

Safety systems work continuously to protect you and your passengers. Enhanced automatic emergency braking, rear cross traffic alert, lane change alert with side blind zone detection, and automatic parking assist combine with four-wheel disc brakes and multiple airbag protection to create a comprehensive safety environment. The rear camera mirror offers clear visibility where it matters most.

With 55,393 miles and the commanding road presence of a full-size luxury SUV, this Escalade is ready for your ownership. Visit us to experience the combination of Cadillac's commitment to luxury, the capability of its engineering, and the satisfaction that comes with driving a vehicle built to exacting standards.

The power driver seat with memory settings allows multiple users to quickly find their preferred position.

Safety technology is integrated throughout. The Blind Spot Information System alerts you to vehicles in adjacent lanes, while the Lane Keeping Assist System helps maintain your position on the road. Collision Mitigation Braking automatically applies brakes if a frontal collision is imminent, working in concert with Forward Collision Warning. The system includes multiple airbags, electronic stability control, and four-wheel disc ABS brakes to protect occupants.

Technology features enhance every drive. The 215-watt audio system with seven speakers delivers rich sound, and SiriusXM satellite radio provides access to hundreds of channels. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto ensure your smartphone integrates seamlessly, while steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your focus on the road. The auto-dimming rearview mirror and automatic headlights with delay-off functionality add practical convenience.

This Special Edition Pilot represents excellent value for those seeking a well-maintained three-row SUV with premium features and Safety Connect technology. We invite you to schedule a visit and discover why this vehicle deserves serious consideration for your next purchase.

The Cargo Convenience Package includes organizational solutions to maximize truck bed utility.

The exterior White Frost Tricoat finish commands attention on any road. Premium 22" wheels add visual presence while the body-color molded splash guards and chrome accents reflect the attention to detail throughout the truck. LED fog lamps and power-folding heated mirrors are both functional and stylish.

This Sierra 1500 Denali is ready for whoever is ready for it. Whether your needs involve serious work, weekend adventures, or simply commanding presence on the road, this truck delivers substance and style.

This 2025 Chevrolet Trailblazer LT offers practical performance and everyday reliability for drivers seeking a versatile compact SUV with confident handling and efficient fuel economy.

- Marina Blue Metallic exterior finish
- Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity
- 6-Speaker Audio System with SiriusXM Trial Subscription
- Fully Automatic Headlights with Delay-off Feature
- Power door mirrors with heating function
- Rear Exterior Parking Camera
- 17 High Gloss Black Machined Aluminum Wheels
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- Dual Front Impact and Side Impact Airbags
- Remote Keyless Entry
- Telescoping and Tilt Steering Wheel
- Climate Control Air Conditioning with Rear Window Defroster
- Split Folding Rear Seat for flexible cargo space
- OnStar and Chevrolet Connected Services Capability
- Type-A and Type-C USB Ports

Under the hood, this Trailblazer features a 1.3L turbocharged three-cylinder engine paired with a nine-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive, delivering 26 city miles per gallon and 29 highway miles per gallon for balanced efficiency on varied driving conditions. The responsive steering and composed suspension provide confident maneuverability whether navigating city streets or highway routes.

The interior emphasizes comfort and functionality with front bucket seats, a front center armrest, and cloth trim throughout. The split-folding rear seat expands cargo flexibility for weekend trips or larger loads, while the flat-folding front passenger seatback accommodates extended items. Illuminated entry and overhead console lighting enhance nighttime convenience.

Safety systems are comprehensive, including four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, dual front and side impact airbags, knee and overhead airbags, rear side impact airbags, brake assist, and low tire pressure warning. Electronic stability control works with traction control to maintain grip and stability across varying road surfaces.

Convenience features include steering wheel-mounted audio controls, speed control, power windows and door mirrors, and a trip computer with compass display. The rear window wiper and variably intermittent front wipers adapt to weather conditions automatically.

This Trailblazer LT represents smart SUV ownership delivering the capability and space you need with the efficiency and reliability you expect. The combination of all-wheel drive, practical seating, and modern connectivity makes this vehicle ready for whatever your day demands.

- Convertible roof lining with glass rear window

- Power door mirrors with auto-dimming function and integrated heating

Audio entertainment is handled by the harman/kardon® system, delivering clarity through ten speakers for your favorite AM/FM or CD selections. Climate control maintains comfort with air conditioning and rear window defroster, while heated seats provide warmth during cooler conditions. The fully automatic headlights work seamlessly with rain-sensing wipers to adapt to changing weather.

Safety features demonstrate BMW's commitment to driver protection, with a comprehensive airbag system, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, and electronic stability enhancements. The speed-sensing power steering provides responsive handling while the independent suspension ensures composed ride quality. Traction control and integrated roll-over protection add confidence whether navigating city streets or enjoying open roads.

This Z4 achieves respectable fuel economy, delivering 21 city and 29 highway miles per gallon, making it practical for regular driving while maintaining the performance character expected from this model. The convertible roof lining and glass rear window enhance the driving experience, allowing you to enjoy the open air whenever weather permits.

We invite you to experience this 2004 BMW Z4 3.0i in person and discover what makes it a compelling choice for sports car enthusiasts who value both performance and refinement.

The overhead console and illuminated entry help you navigate easily, while the Electronically Controlled Throttle ensures responsive engine management. The heavy-duty engine cooling system supports reliable operation even in demanding conditions.

Safety features are comprehensive, with dual front impact airbags, overhead airbags, and front wheel independent suspension working with the anti-roll bars front and rear. Low tire pressure warning keeps you informed about tire health, while brake assist and the anti-spin differential rear axle provide additional control and security on the road.

This Ram 1500 SLT offers the solid truck capability and power you need, backed by practical features designed for everyday use and utility. Visit us today to see this truck in person and discuss how it can meet your transportation needs.
